meta.title: Support at MepMail — email, docs, changelog
meta.description: How to get help with MepMail: email support, the documentation, the changelog, and answers to the questions we get most — migration, domains, plan limits, billing and spam folders.

hero.title: Support at MepMail
hero.lead: MepMail is founder-operated: the people who build it answer the email. Pick the channel that fits — most questions are already answered in the docs.
hero.note: Support runs on a small team, so please include the account email with any question.

channels.title: Where to reach us

items.q: How do I migrate from Resend?
items.a: Point the official Resend SDKs at MepMail's base URL, swap the API key, and move your domains and contacts. The free account can be migrated with npx @mepmail/cli migrate --from resend. The per-language guide walks through each SDK.

items.q: How do I connect and verify a domain?
items.a: Add the domain in the panel and publish the DNS records it returns: the DKIM record and the MAIL FROM (SPF) record. Those two gate sending, DMARC is recommended, and the panel reports each record's live state until it resolves.

Every plan carries an included monthly volume and a daily send ceiling. Volume is counted per distinct recipient, and sends past the included volume are billed per 1,000 at the plan's overage rate. Prices and volumes are on the pricing page.

items.q: How do billing and refunds work?
items.a: Paid plans are billed in US dollars through Stripe, monthly and in advance. If a charge looks wrong, email us with the charge reference; refunds go back to the original payment method, typically within 5-10 business days depending on your bank.

items.q: Why did my email land in spam?
items.a: Usually DNS or reputation: a DKIM or MAIL FROM record that does not resolve, a DMARC policy that fails, or a domain with no sending history. MepMail's deliverability insights score each sending domain and point at the record that is failing.

items.q: How do I report abuse or spam?
items.a: Email security@je4ndev.com with the message id or the headers. We act on abuse reports, and sending that generates complaints can be paused or the account suspended.

close.title: Nothing here answered it?
close.body: Send the account email and what you expected to happen — that is usually enough to get a concrete answer.
